t: The constitution of 1886, inspired by Rafael Núñez, made Colombia a centralised Catholic republic and lasted, much amended, until 1991.
The republic lost Panama in 1903 and lived through La Violencia and a long armed conflict with guerrillas, paramilitaries and cartels.
The constitution of 1991 and the 2016 peace agreement with the FARC reshaped a country that now has about 53 million people.
dyk: Rafael Núñez, the president behind the constitution of 1886, also wrote the words of Colombia’s national anthem, “¡Oh gloria inmarcesible!”, made official in 1920.
ev: The constitution of August 1886 creates the centralised Republic of Colombia
